# Curbside Rentals

Curbside Rentals Inc. rents commercial step vans to delivery and moving businesses in Central Ontario.

- Owner: Candice O'Sullivan
- Phone: 519-288-6651
- Email: candice@curbsiderentalsinc.com
- Based in Orangeville, Ontario, Canada
- Service areas: Owen Sound, Barrie, the Greater Toronto Area, and Central Ontario
- Delivery: trucks are delivered to the customer; local delivery is $100 round trip within 100 km of Orangeville, Ontario
- Vehicle: 18 ft commercial step van with about 900 cu. ft. cargo space, 120 sq. ft. floor space, and up to 4,000 lb load capacity
- Daily rental: $150/day plus fees, mileage, delivery, and HST
- Mileage: $0.99/km with no included free kilometres
- Fuel: gasoline; return at the same fuel level
- Security hold: $500 credit card authorization
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM; Sunday closed
- Sunday returns are not available
